BiblicalUsage: gibʻâh is the word for hill. I meet it 71 times across the Bible, and Genesis is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What gibʻâh tells me is that God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
